description: Hold an exclusive task for the user (default 24h) and get its draft, tracked link and proof rule. Pick tasks in places the user is ALREADY a member of — ask them. Membership tasks need attest_member:true (the USER confirms; never assume) and profile_url. Then: help the user rewrite draft_text in their own voice and post it THEMSELVES; then submit_campaign_work with task_id. If they can't, release_task. Open tasks need no claim. Free.

attest_member.description: The USER confirmed they are already a member there

profile_url.description: The user's profile in that place, or a public profile
